_comment: Curated conflict-zone airspace closures and overflight warnings. Geometry = the country's polygon from dashboard/public/geo/world-110m.geojson (a2). Review monthly against EASA CZIBs (easa.europa.eu/domains/air-operations/czibs), FAA SFARs/NOTAMs (faa.gov/air_traffic/publications/us_restrictions) and safeairspace.net. These are not NOTAM-precise boundaries.

zones.label: Ukraine — airspace closed
zones.note: Entire Ukrainian airspace closed to civil traffic since 24 Feb 2022; EASA CZIB do-not-fly.

zones.label: Russia — do not fly (EASA/FAA)
zones.note: EASA do-not-fly for all Russian airspace; FAA prohibits US operators (SFAR 113). Russia bars most Western carriers.

zones.label: Belarus — do not fly
zones.note: EASA and FAA advise against all operations in Belarusian airspace (Minsk FIR).

zones.label: Iran — do not fly below FL320 / avoid
zones.note: FAA prohibits US operators in Tehran FIR; EASA advises against operations at all levels since 2024 strikes.

zones.label: Iraq — restricted below FL320
zones.note: Overflight permitted above FL320 only; no landings for US operators except as specified.

zones.label: Syria — do not fly
zones.note: Prohibited for US operators; EASA do-not-fly at all levels.

zones.label: Yemen — do not fly
zones.note: Sanaa FIR: active conflict, anti-aircraft and missile risk; FAA prohibits US operators.

zones.label: Libya — do not fly
zones.note: Tripoli FIR prohibited for US operators; EASA do-not-fly.

zones.label: Sudan — airspace closed
zones.note: Khartoum FIR closed to civil traffic since April 2023 fighting, limited corridors.

zones.label: Somalia — restricted below FL260
zones.note: Mogadishu FIR: overflight above FL260 only; surface-to-air weapon risk.

zones.label: Afghanistan — restricted below FL320
zones.note: Kabul FIR: overflight above FL320 only, no ATC services below.

zones.label: North Korea — do not fly
zones.note: Pyongyang FIR prohibited for US operators; unannounced missile launches.

zones.label: Israel — conflict zone bulletin
zones.note: Tel Aviv FIR: EASA advises caution; recurrent closures during missile exchanges. Check live NOTAMs.

zones.label: Lebanon — avoid
zones.note: Beirut FIR: EASA advises against operations; FAA prohibits US operators.

zones.label: Mali — restricted below FL260
zones.note: Niamey FIR portion: overflight above FL260 recommended; armed-group MANPADS risk.

zones.label: Pakistan — avoid border zones
zones.note: Lahore/Karachi FIR: overflight caution near Indian border and western provinces; periodic closures.
